events.title: Steam Playtest Live Now. Come Hunt or Be Hunted!
events.summary: The playtest is live and we want you in it.Hantu and Hunted is a 4v2 asymmetric horror prop hunt. Four humans morph into objects to survive the night. Two Hantu(ghosts) drawn from Southeast Asian folklore hunt them down. But hiding won't save you forever, and not every prop is what it seems.This is an early build and we're testing it with the community first. Your feedback directly shapes where the game goes, balance, mechanics, the hunt itself.How to get in: Join our Discord and grab a playtest
